svg.aria-label: When both countries claim you: four steps, in order
svg.text: When both countries claim you: four steps, in order
A permanent home available to you
Available, not lived in. A flat kept empty in Britain is available. If a home is available in both: centre of vital interests
Reached only if the centre of vital interests cannot be determined, or no home is available in either state
The passport is the third step of four, not the first
Only for a national of both states or of neither
Article 4(3) of the convention signed 12 April 2016, in force 25 December 2016.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 9 September 2026
